profile_text.body:
Twilio describes itself as a platform for building customer experiences, offering APIs for SMS, RCS, voice, and email alongside conversational AI and identity verification. According to its site, the platform connects communication channels, customer context, and AI in one place, with flexible plans and pay-as-you-go pricing. The company says its AI agents draw on internal knowledge and real-time data, and that they hand conversations to human agents based on complexity or customer intent, transferring full context so customers do not repeat themselves. Twilio frames this as serving the "agentic era," with humans and AI agents coordinating across channels.

Twilio is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, California, and trades under the ticker TWLO. Its SEC central index key is 0001447669.

The company's legal exposure record counts 220 cases in California.
